lines: Written against: vue 3.5.39, 12 delivered packages; qrcode 1.5.0, 4 delivered packages.
Other delivered libraries: 26, axios 1.18.1, dompurify 3.4.13, buffer 6.0.3, focus-trap 8.2.2, semver 7.7.4, @floating-ui/core 1.7.5, and 20 more.

103 delivered files carry no source map, 3 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
2 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
